Hi Andrew —

Congrats on the usage growth this year, and thanks for the heads-up that your renewal is coming up in August. I wanted to start the SOC 2 re-attestation conversation early so we can coordinate evidence handoff and the retention changes you mentioned on our call. A few concrete asks from our side to shape a proposal:

- Can you confirm the target retention window you need for audit logs (current prod window = 30 days)? You mentioned 90–180 days as a preference.
- Are you open to an automated S3 archival transfer for bulk evidence (we can provide presigned PUTs + a manifest), or do you need direct streaming to a third-party archive?
- Any expected seat/capacity increase tied to the retention change? We want to price the amendment accurately.

I've attached last year's attestation and a draft manifest template for exports. Lauren is looped in to outline commercial options if you go with extended retention.

If it helps, we can do a short technical runbook session this week (20–30m) to map S3 lifecycle rules, encryption/KMS key scopes, and a one-day dry run for a small subset of logs.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm target retention and whether S3 presigned uploads work (reply).
2) We scope capacity uplift + draft amendment and share DocuSign for signature.
3) Technical dry run and full evidence transfer window.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks for kicking this off. A few answers up front:
- We're targeting 180 days for audit logs for this renewal term (regulatory change on our side).
- S3 presigned uploads sound ideal — AuditOps prefers the manifest approach so they can verify checksums and ingestion order.
- Yes, we will likely increase committed throughput by one shard (estimate +30% token throughput) to cover peak hours if the retention change increases read/backfill load.

Quick questions for your team (cc Helen to make sure AuditOps' expectations line up):
1) Do you have a recommended manifest schema (fields, checksum algo, gzipped vs plain)?
2) What's the expected delta in monthly cost for 180-day retention + an extra shard? We need a ballpark for our procurement team.

We can block 30m on Friday for the runbook. Also, Helen: would you prefer us to ingest into our central evidence bucket or leave it in Brightline's S3 and grant AuditOps read-only access?

Thanks —

Team —

Plan and technical notes (high level):

1) Transfer flow
- We'll provision temporary presigned PUT URLs for Brightline's export process. Files must be gzipped and include a sidecar JSON line in the manifest with SHA256 checksums.
- Manifest schema: filename, size_bytes, timestamp_utc, sha256_hex, gzip=true, record_count. (Attached sample in the manifest CSV.)

2) Encryption / keys
- Brightline will supply a customer-managed KMS ARN. We will accept objects encrypted with that key in the target bucket; our ingestion job will only read for attest verification and then snapshot to our internal cold archive for SOC 2 processing (read-only to AuditOps).

3) Retention / capacity impact
- Moving from 30d -> 180d increases average storage egress and snapshot read windows. Estimated delta: ~+0.9 TB/month storage for their current ingest rate (see rough calc below).
- Performance uplift: +1 shard (30% throughput) looks right for peak windows; we can provision a Dedicated capacity slot for the renewal term. Commercial uplift estimate: one-time archiving setup fee USD 2,500 + monthly increase USD 3,200 (storage + dedicated shard) — ballpark until finance finalizes.

4) Dry run
- Dry-run steps: create 3 presigned PUTs, upload a 1–2GB gzipped bundle, run manifest validation, run checksum verification. We propose Jun 26 for dry-run and Jun 28 for a full transfer window if dry-run passes.

5) AuditOps needs and acceptance
- Manifest validation: strict ordering and SHA256; AuditOps will run a sample validation job.

Questions for legal/commercial (Karthik / Lauren):
- Do we need a short amendment to the MSA to capture retention and KMS responsibilities?
- Do we offer a discounted rate if Brightline signs a 24-month renewal with the retention uplift?

Jonas
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
